sentences.text: Lord, I choose you again today.
I want my words, my reactions, and my plans to reflect that choice.
When I am tempted to bring stress into every room, remind me whose house this really is.
Help me lead by example rather than lecture.
Let the people around me notice something of your kindness in the way I listen and the way I respond.
Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it:
except the LORD keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

sentences.text: Teach them yourself.
Guard their minds from what would harm them, and their hearts from believing they are unloved.
Give them friends who are kind and teachers who are wise.
When they make mistakes today, let them find grace rather than shame.
Let your peace be great within them, deeper than the pressures they face at school or online.
Lord, some of the children I love are carrying fears they cannot explain.
A test, a friendship that has changed, a worry about home, or something they saw on a screen.
Give them courage that is bigger than their fear.
Help me notice when something is wrong, and give me gentle words to ask about it.
Let them know they can always come to me, and always come to you.

sentences.text: Lord, thank you for my family.
Thank you for the laughter we have shared, the meals we have eaten together, and the ordinary moments that will one day be precious memories.
Thank you for the person who made coffee, fixed something, or sent a kind message.
Help me say thank you out loud today, so that gratitude is not only in my heart but in our home.
Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

sentences.text: I can say thank you out loud.
I can honor the people I love with simple acts of kindness.
God's mercy reaches my family today and the generations that come after us.
Choose one person from your home or your family right now.
Decide on one simple act of love for them today, and when you will do it.
It might be, when my daughter gets home from school, I will put my phone away and ask about her day.
Or, at lunch I will send my mother a message of thanks.
Keep it small and specific enough to actually do.

to such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

sentences.text: Where I have been stubborn, soften me.
Where I need to speak up, give me words seasoned with grace.
Help us keep the bond of peace, even when we see things differently.
Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
Lord, make me swift to hear the people I love.
Slow my tongue when I want to correct, interrupt, or win.
Help me hear the worry behind a sharp comment and the tiredness behind a short answer.
When anger rises in me today, let it slow down long enough for wisdom to catch up.
Teach me to listen the way you listen to me.

sentences.text: Father, families come in many shapes.
Some of us are raising children who are not biologically ours.
Some are blending two households into one.
Some are caring for a relative alone.
Some are waiting and hoping for children.
Meet each of us in our particular situation.
Give wisdom to every parent, guardian, and caregiver, and let every child feel wanted, chosen, and safe.
In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence:
and his children shall have a place of refuge.

and thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

sentences.text: Father, make our home a refuge.
When someone walks through the door discouraged, let them find comfort here.
When someone fails, let them find mercy here before they find consequences.
Give me a steady heart so that my own fears do not fill the house.
Let the confidence I have in you settle the atmosphere, so that each person feels safe to rest and to speak.
Stay with me.
In a moment, picture each face as we pray.
Take a quiet moment now.
Picture the faces of the people you live with or love most.
You do not need to say anything about them yet.
Simply hold them in your mind, and let God see them with you.

sentences.text: Be the one who watches over us.
Where we have built on hurry or fear, rebuild us on trust.
Where our foundations feel cracked, strengthen them with your faithfulness and patient love.
Lord, I pray for the person I share my life with, or for the relationship closest to my heart.
Give them strength for whatever today asks of them.
Where there has been distance between us, bring us back toward each other.
Help me notice their efforts instead of only their faults.
Let my words today build them up, and let our partnership reflect your faithfulness.
Next, the children you love, whatever their age.
